description:
The image depicts a street sign situated in a residential area, with the sign itself being the central focus. The sign is white with black lettering and features the words "HURST GROVE" prominently displayed at the top, followed by the phrase "Street Pride" in smaller text underneath. The sign is mounted on a black pole, which is surrounded by a mix of brown and green vegetation.

In the background, several houses are visible, with a car parked on the street to the right
